jobs.title: Infant development program specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

As an Infant Development Program Specialist, you’ll support infants and young children with developmental delays and disabilities through individualized, play-based learning. You’ll plan and deliver early intervention activities, partner with families, and coordinate with educators and other professionals to help each child build communication, social, cognitive, and motor skills. Your impact: By adapting instruction to each child’s needs and working closely with families, you help children participate more fully in everyday learning and routines.

**Responsibilities**

* Observe children’s development and use findings to guide lesson planning, curriculum development, and individualized education program (IEP) goals.
* Provide early intervention, preschool special education, and developmentally appropriate childcare, including toddler care when needed.
* Use classroom management and positive behavior management strategies; apply applied behavior analysis (ABA) principles when appropriate.
* Collaborate with families, speech therapy providers, and other professionals to coordinate student support.
* Maintain accurate records and follow applicable educational compliance requirements; use learning technology and standardized assessments as appropriate.

**Skills**

* Experience in early childhood education, classroom teaching, preschool, daycare, childcare, or private school settings; experience working with children and students with disabilities or developmental delays is valuable.
* Knowledge of special education, deaf education, literacy education, math, childhood development, child welfare, and special education law is an asset.
* Familiarity with behavioral therapy, behavior support for students with special needs, physical education, and teaching students with developmental disabilities is preferred.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with families and multidisciplinary teams.
* Understanding of educational regulations and experience supporting children with autism or other developmental disabilities is preferred.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sherman Oaks, CA 91423

jobs.description:
**Job no:** 563482  
**Work type:** Staff  
**Location:** Long Beach  
**Categories:** Confidential, Administrative, Temporary, Full Time

Join the vibrant community at California State University, Long Beach (CSULB)!

Located just three miles from the Pacific Ocean, CSULB offers an inspiring workplace and an exceptional Southern California lifestyle. Our 322-acre campus—one of the largest in the CSU system—serves more than 42,000 students and is known for its commitment to student success, innovation, and impactful academic and research initiatives.

As a member of the CSULB community, you’ll experience a dynamic environment filled with cultural landmarks, collaborative energy, and opportunities to make a meaningful difference.

Work-life balance thrives here. Long Beach blends coastal relaxation with urban vibrancy, offering miles of beaches, year-round sunshine, a thriving arts and food scene, and convenient access to both Los Angeles and Orange County. It’s an ideal place to grow your career while enjoying everything Southern California has to offer.

Join the California State University (CSU) and explore career opportunities that advance student success and strengthen California’s future—offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and professional growth.

Under general direction, the incumbent administers and coordinates the Driver Authorization and Safe Driver Program, ensuring driver applications, training, compliance requirements, and related documentation are accurately maintained and processed. The position also provides support for HR programs and operations, including background screening, training and recognition, exit surveys, Fee Waiver, Staff Emeritus, and other departmental and administrative activities.

This position also provides strategic program support involving a variety of employee and labor relations function within Staff Human Resources. This role grants the incumbent access to management's strategies and positions on collective bargaining negotiations at CSU Long Beach.

* DRIVER AUTHORIZATION & SAFE DRIVER PROGRAM. Coordinates the campus Driver Authorization and Safe Driver Program, including driver applications, required training, DMV/EPN monitoring, compliance tracking, audits, and communication with campus departments.
* DEPARTMENT & ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT. Provides administrative and operational support for HRM, including website and guideline updates, purchasing and budget support, facilities coordination, and special projects.
* HR PROGRAM & PROJECT SUPPORT. Provides backup support for Fee Waiver and is the primary support for the Staff Emeritus program, assisting with program administration, records, communications, reporting, and customer service.
* BACKGROUND SCREENING. Coordinates background screening and Live Scan processes for guests and volunteers, including initiation, tracking, documentation, and communication of results.
* RECOGNITION PROGRAMS. Supports employee training and recognition programs through event coordination, course administration, SharePoint updates, and tracking of participation and feedback.
* EXIT SURVEY FOLLOW-UP. Coordinates follow-up with separated employees to support completion of Exit Surveys and prepares related tracking reports for management.

### **Department**

Staff Human Resources

### **Time Base**

1.0 time-base, 40 hours per week.

### **Duration of Appointment**

This is a temporary position for 1 year with no permanent status granted. Temporary assignments may expire prior to the ending date.

### **Classification**

Confidential Administrative Support I

### **Compensation**

Salary placement is determined by the education, experience, and qualifications the candidate brings to the position, internal equity, and the hiring department’s fiscal resources.

* Hiring Range: The hiring range for this position is $4,261 - $5,000 per month commensurate with candidate's education, experience, skills, and training.
* CSU Classification Salary Range: The CSU Classification Salary Range for this position is $4,261 - $8,166 per month.

### **Benefits**

At California State University (CSU), we prioritize the health, growth, and success of our employees. Our benefits program reflects our commitment to your overall well-being.

To be eligible for full benefits, employees must be appointed at least half-time (.50 FTE) with an appointment lasting more than six months and one day. Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on appointment type, classification, and applicable collective bargaining agreement. Eligible employees may have access to a comprehensive benefits package that can include:

* **Paid Time Off:** Up to 24 vacation days per year (based on employee group and/or length of service), 14 paid holidays, and 12 sick days annually with unlimited accrual.
* **Health Coverage:** A variety of medical, dental, and vision plans.
* **Retirement Plans:** Participation in the CalPERS defined benefit plan, along with voluntary savings options such as 403(b), 401(k), and 457 plans.
* **Educational Benefits:** Tuition fee waiver programs for eligible employees; dependent eligibility varies by employee group and bargaining unit.
* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** Confidential counseling and support services for employees and their families.
* **Additional Benefits:** Wellness programs, professional development opportunities, and insurance options including life, disability, and pet insurance.

Candidates are encouraged to review the appropriate CSU Employee Benefits Summary for details specific to their position. Additionally, the CSU Total Compensation Calculator is available to help prospective employees understand the full value of the CSU benefits package and how it complements base salary.

jobs.description:
**About GitGuardian**
---------------------

GitGuardian is a global cybersecurity scale-up with offices in Paris, New York City, and Boston.

Our early investors include Scott Chacon, co-founder of GitHub, and Solomon Hykes, co-founder of Docker, alongside leading US and European VC firms. We raised our Series C in early 2026.

GitGuardian helps enterprises close credential-based breach paths. It finds secrets wherever they live, prioritizes remediation based on rich context, and prevents new exposure across code, systems, and AI. The GitGuardian platform is already used by more than 600K developers worldwide and by 50 of the Fortune 500!

**About your team and your mission**
------------------------------------

Our Growth market segment covers companies with up to 1,000 employees. It’s a fast-moving, high-volume space where strong outbound instincts and a relentless prospecting mindset make all the difference.

You will join our Business Development team in New York or Boston, working closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Jason, our Head of Business Development. More than 70% of our customers are in the US, so you’ll be at the heart of our largest market.

This is a high-velocity role. Your main mission is to generate qualified pipeline by finding and engaging security, engineering, and DevOps decision-makers at companies that could benefit from GitGuardian. You will be the first touchpoint for many of our future customers.

**About you**
-------------

*If you think you match at least 70% of these criteria, please apply!*

Here's what we consider essential for success in this role:

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Prior experience in a sales or outbound role, such as BDR, SDR, Inside Sales, or a similar position where you were actively prospecting or selling.
* You are a hunter and find creative ways to prospect and engage the targeted profiles.
* You’re comfortable with a high-volume motion selling to SMB and growth-market companies. You’re energized by activity and quick cycles, and you consider yourself agile.
* Real curiosity about the GitGuardian product and the cybersecurity space. You don’t need to be a technical expert, but you’re keen to understand what you’re selling.
* You’re a self-starter who thrives in a lean environment and doesn’t need a large team, heavy process, or a built-out playbook to get going.
* Positivity, coachability, and a willingness to grow in the role.  
    
  **The following skills would strengthen your application but aren’t required:**

* Direct BDR experience at a tech or SaaS company in New York or Boston.
* Experience at a small startup or scale-up: you understand what it means to build things from scratch.
* Familiarity with GitGuardian, secrets detection, AppSec, or the DevSecOps ecosystem.
* Hands-on experience with modern outbound tools: a CRM (HubSpot is a plus), sales engagement platforms, or prospecting tools.

**The interview process**
-------------------------

**1. Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member**  
*A first chat to learn about your professional experience and motivation, and to see if there could be a mutual match.*

**2. Interview with the Hiring Manager**  
*A conversation with* Jason, Head of Business Development *to learn more about your achievements and introduce you to the team and the role.*

**3. Business case + BDR team (onsite in New York)**  
*An onsite round combining your hybrid business case presentation with team interviews. You’ll meet members of the BDR team and possibly a leader from the sales or marketing team in person.*

**4.1 Executive interview**  
A final interview with Rachel, our VP GTM Americas, and/or Eric, our CEO, to go over our company’s vision and ambitions for the global sales team.

**4.2 Reference check**  
Start thinking about two people who can speak to your previous or current professional experience. They should be as recent as possible, and we will call them at the end of the process.

**Benefits**
------------

* 25 days of PTO (employees are strongly encouraged to use all of it!)
* ️ 10 public holidays
* 401(k) + 3% matching! with Empower
* ‍️ Health, Dental & Vision insurance (80% coverage), for individuals and their families
* Short-term & long-term disability insurance (100% paid)
* Travel policy and annual off-site
* $70 monthly remote work stipend
* $4000 referral bonus
* FSA and HSA

And also...

* Remote policy: hybrid
* Long-term career development opportunities

**More about GitGuardian!**
---------------------------

**Products**

* Understand how GitGuardian works in this short video!
* Want to go even further? Check out our public roadmap!
* Check out the State of Secrets Sprawl Report to understand our mission and the industry.
* Our solutions are already used by hundreds of thousands of developers in all industries and **GitGuardian platform is the n°1 app on the** GitHub marketplace

**Clients**

* GitGuardian helps organizations find exposed sensitive information that could often lead to tens of millions of dollars in potential damage.
* More than 70% of our customers are in the United States.
* Many F500 companies use GitGuardian's platform.

**People**

* The Guardians are **knowledgeable**, committed, serious, **aligned with the company’s mission, and true team players**: always willing to help each other grow our skill sets!
* The team is diverse and we hail from more than 20 different countries.

An Assistant Community Manager will be asked to assume greater responsibilities upon absorbing and applying knowledge of all aspects of property management as well as displaying maturity and good judgment. The Assistant Community Manager serves as the individual responsible for the property in the absence of the Community Director and serves as a role model to peers.

jobs.title: Independent Sales Representative – Audio Advertising & Creative Services
jobs.description:
Somewhere, a business owner is about to approve another ad nobody will remember. We’d like you to interrupt that meeting. Politely, preferably. Nugget Radio is looking for independent sales representatives who can spot an opportunity, start a genuine conversation and help a business find its voice. Sometimes that voice comes with a ridiculously catchy chorus. Great Music. Strange Company. Forever Free. That’s our station. Behind it is Rafa Brands LLC, and we’re building a creative-services business around original musical advertising, good ideas and people willing to do something a little different. WHAT YOU’LL BE SELLING We’re starting with custom jingles and musical advertisements, plus Nugget Radio placement opportunities under approved campaign terms. As our offerings develop, there will also be website, merchandise-store and social-content packages to discuss with the right clients. A neighborhood café. An artist. A pet business. A contractor with a great service and an advertisement that sounds like everyone else’s. There are plenty of conversations worth having. YOUR SIDE OF THE MICROPHONE Find businesses. Learn what they need. Show them relevant examples. Explain our approved offers. Follow up. Bring in paying clients with a clear brief so we can deliver what was promised. You can meet people locally, use your existing relationships, pick up the phone or prospect online. You don’t need to sit in our office. There isn’t an attendance prize. Keep your leads organized and your promises accurate. Final pricing, scope and unusual requests go through us. We won’t ask you to invent listener numbers, guarantee somebody’s sales or sell services we aren’t ready to deliver. YOU MIGHT FIT HERE IF… **You can talk with a business owner like a person, not a sales script wearing shoes.**  You know how to listen, explain value and ask for the business. **You follow up without needing someone to chase you.**  You’re comfortable with basic digital tools and keeping useful records. **You enjoy music, creative ideas and helping independent businesses get noticed.**  You understand that building a client base takes actual work. Sales experience is useful. Existing business relationships are useful. A résumé containing the word “synergy” seventeen times is not required. LET’S TALK MONEY This is a commission-based contract opportunity, not a salaried position. Earnings depend on sales. We’re an early-stage business, so we’re not going to dress up a guess as a guaranteed annual income. You’ll receive written terms covering commission rates, eligible sales and payment timing before work begins. Customers pay the business directly; we handle billing and creative production. We’re also building in two things that matter: **Sales-training assistance funded from a portion of business sales, separate from your commission.**  Referral rewards for introducing additional sales representatives to the team. The budgets, rewards and qualifying terms will be defined in writing. Flexible scheduling is part of the arrangement. WHERE YOU FIT Chicago is our initial recruiting focus, but we’re open to discussing other territories. Local visits, phone conversations and online outreach can all have a place here. INTERESTED? Tell us what you’ve sold, which kinds of businesses you understand and how you would start a conversation about an ad that’s actually a song. We’ll bring the music. Bring your curiosity, your follow-through and a little personality. Nugget Radio · Rafa Brands LLC

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program

Work Location: On the road

new_jobs.description:
**About GitGuardian**
---------------------

GitGuardian is a global cybersecurity scale-up with offices in Paris, New York City, and Boston.

Our early investors include Scott Chacon, co-founder of GitHub, and Solomon Hykes, co-founder of Docker, alongside leading US and European VC firms. We raised our Series C in early 2026.

GitGuardian helps enterprises close credential-based breach paths. It finds secrets wherever they live, prioritizes remediation based on rich context, and prevents new exposure across code, systems, and AI. The GitGuardian platform is already used by more than 600K developers worldwide and by 50 of the Fortune 500!

**About your team and your mission**
------------------------------------

Our Growth market segment covers companies with up to 1,000 employees. It’s a fast-moving, high-volume space where strong outbound instincts and a relentless prospecting mindset make all the difference.

You will join our Business Development team in New York or Boston, working closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Jason, our Head of Business Development. More than 70% of our customers are in the US, so you’ll be at the heart of our largest market.

This is a high-velocity role. Your main mission is to generate qualified pipeline by finding and engaging security, engineering, and DevOps decision-makers at companies that could benefit from GitGuardian. You will be the first touchpoint for many of our future customers.

**About you**
-------------

*If you think you match at least 70% of these criteria, please apply!*

Here's what we consider essential for success in this role:

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Prior experience in a sales or outbound role, such as BDR, SDR, Inside Sales, or a similar position where you were actively prospecting or selling.
* You are a hunter and find creative ways to prospect and engage the targeted profiles.
* You’re comfortable with a high-volume motion selling to SMB and growth-market companies. You’re energized by activity and quick cycles, and you consider yourself agile.
* Real curiosity about the GitGuardian product and the cybersecurity space. You don’t need to be a technical expert, but you’re keen to understand what you’re selling.
* You’re a self-starter who thrives in a lean environment and doesn’t need a large team, heavy process, or a built-out playbook to get going.
* Positivity, coachability, and a willingness to grow in the role.  
    
  **The following skills would strengthen your application but aren’t required:**

* Direct BDR experience at a tech or SaaS company in New York or Boston.
* Experience at a small startup or scale-up: you understand what it means to build things from scratch.
* Familiarity with GitGuardian, secrets detection, AppSec, or the DevSecOps ecosystem.
* Hands-on experience with modern outbound tools: a CRM (HubSpot is a plus), sales engagement platforms, or prospecting tools.

**The interview process**
-------------------------

**1. Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member**  
*A first chat to learn about your professional experience and motivation, and to see if there could be a mutual match.*

**2. Interview with the Hiring Manager**  
*A conversation with* Jason, Head of Business Development *to learn more about your achievements and introduce you to the team and the role.*

**3. Business case + BDR team (onsite in New York)**  
*An onsite round combining your hybrid business case presentation with team interviews. You’ll meet members of the BDR team and possibly a leader from the sales or marketing team in person.*

**4.1 Executive interview**  
A final interview with Rachel, our VP GTM Americas, and/or Eric, our CEO, to go over our company’s vision and ambitions for the global sales team.

**4.2 Reference check**  
Start thinking about two people who can speak to your previous or current professional experience. They should be as recent as possible, and we will call them at the end of the process.

**Benefits**
------------

* 25 days of PTO (employees are strongly encouraged to use all of it!)
* ️ 10 public holidays
* 401(k) + 3% matching! with Empower
* ‍️ Health, Dental & Vision insurance (80% coverage), for individuals and their families
* Short-term & long-term disability insurance (100% paid)
* Travel policy and annual off-site
* $70 monthly remote work stipend
* $4000 referral bonus
* FSA and HSA

And also...

* Remote policy: hybrid
* Long-term career development opportunities

**More about GitGuardian!**
---------------------------

**Products**

* Understand how GitGuardian works in this short video!
* Want to go even further? Check out our public roadmap!
* Check out the State of Secrets Sprawl Report to understand our mission and the industry.
* Our solutions are already used by hundreds of thousands of developers in all industries and **GitGuardian platform is the n°1 app on the** GitHub marketplace

**Clients**

* GitGuardian helps organizations find exposed sensitive information that could often lead to tens of millions of dollars in potential damage.
* More than 70% of our customers are in the United States.
* Many F500 companies use GitGuardian's platform.

**People**

* The Guardians are **knowledgeable**, committed, serious, **aligned with the company’s mission, and true team players**: always willing to help each other grow our skill sets!
* The team is diverse and we hail from more than 20 different countries.
* We are also **agile, remote-friendly,** and **fun people** to work with.
* You will get **trust & autonomy** on your perimeter with a very **transparent internal communication** and a strong impact on the company development.
